mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.title, i.content, i.category, i.status, i.priority, i.author_id, i.assignee_id, i.organization_id, i.folder_id, i.created_at, i.updated_at, u1.username AS author_name, u1.email AS author_email, u2.username AS assignee_name, u2.email AS assignee_email FROM issues i LEFT JOIN users u1 ON i.author_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN users u2 ON i.assignee_id = u2.id WHERE i.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO issues ( title, content, category, status, priority, author_id, assignee_id, organization_id, folder_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{content}, #{category}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{authorId}, #{assigneeId}, #{organizationId}, #{folderId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE issues SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, category = #{category}, status = #{status}, priority = #{priority}, assignee_id = #{assigneeId}, folder_id = #{folderId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
